description: Test suite for store operations related to boards and blocks in the focalboard project, including creation, patching, deletion, and duplication of boards and blocks.

methods.name: StoreTestBoardsAndBlocksStore
methods.description: Main test function executing sub-tests for creating, patching, deleting, and duplicating boards and blocks.

methods.name: testCreateBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Tests for creating boards and blocks, including success and failure scenarios, and size limit enforcement.

methods.name: testPatchBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Tests for patching boards and blocks, including success, failure, and size limit enforcement.

methods.name: testDeleteBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Tests for deleting boards and blocks, including validation of ownership, existence, and proper cascading deletion.

methods.name: testDuplicateBoard
methods.description: Tests for duplicating existing boards as templates or copies, including handling non-existent boards.
